scope: 46 candidate races; whole-race quarantine on unavailable history, ambiguous identity or temporal violation. No silent exclusion.
selection: lowest validation race log loss, including uniform baseline
test_policy: no tuning after test; experimental status regardless of result
historical_snapshot_status: retrospective facts; original publication time unproven
tie_policy: single winner only; predicted ties use lowest runner number
minimum_history: missing allowed with train-only imputation and missing indicators
eligibility: No missing labels or identity conflicts; at least 10 eligible races per chronological split. This is a software pilot, not statistical validation.
